summary: The live immutable-execution-pin validator compares every declared workflow/action digest and reference inventory with actual files before it checks updater configuration mutations. An edited Bootstrap workflow therefore needs its gs2-06-4 corpus digest refreshed; that digest contributes to the UTF-8 length-framed canonical seal, so the independent expected seal and architecture success-output literal must change together. The optimistic workflow is separately registered by digest in gs2-06-7 execution-pins-extension.json. Preserve all non-hash registration fields, action/reference pins, complete workflow inventory, mutation controls and historical receipts. A cheap byte/reference sweep catches independent stale registrations together; reproducing the old seal before computing a replacement checks offline derivation but does not replace the canonical F# validator or exact-candidate hosted qualification. This is a repository-specific source-maintenance dependency, not authority to mint accepted receipts, weaken controls, reuse failed attempts or claim delivered/runtime adoption.
title: Workflow byte changes include registered hashes and seal consumers
